LESSON: ORAL EXPRESSION

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.3: Oral Expression
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Oral Expression, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 7 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: What strategies can you use to make effective oral presentations?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. watch an audio-visual clip on common places

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. watch an audio-visual clip on common places

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Oral Expression together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and Problem solving: the learner researches on the common marketplaces found in their neighbourhood and

talks about them.

• Communication and Collaboration: teamwork skills are displayed as the learner participates actively on the role-play related

to the prices of items with peers.

Values:
Integrity: the learner gains awareness of utilising resources prudently when they make sound financial decisions through

budgeting.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Financial Literacy: the learner becomes aware of how to manage their finances and makes sound financial decisions when

discussing the value of budgeting.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

Learning is linked to Pre-technical Studies on prudent management of financial resources.
